author: Kevin Wang (KevinChunye)
method: C++20 PathFinder negotiation (integer, goal-directed bucket-queue searches; exact A* for the initial routing) + exact per-net shortest-path-tree reroute with random equal-delay ties + large-neighbourhood search with negotiated group repair (integer goal-directed searches, exact trees at commit), threshold acceptance from 32 cooling linearly to 0, kicks and return to best, move type chosen by a discounted Thompson-sampling bandit; 4 threads adopting the best every 120 s; one config per tier; from scratch; scale: 300 s per case
